title: Appeals.
bodyText: Notwithstanding section 431:2-308, any person aggrieved by any assessment of the tax for any month or any year may appeal from the assessment in the manner and within the time and in all other respects as provided in section 235-114.
bodyHtml: §431:7-204.5  Appeals.  Notwithstanding section 431:2-308, any person aggrieved by any assessment of the tax for any month or any year may appeal from the assessment in the manner and within the time and in all other respects as provided in section 235-114. [L 1992, c 236, §3; am L 2004, c 123, §12]
